overlapDisclosure.what: Both arms of this pair re-measure tasks whose verdicts already exist: the control arm re-measures the same text that read 21 in the 2026-10-05 window, and four of the candidate's cells (db-wal-recovery, gcode-to-text, sqlite-db-truncate, expr-try-catch-errors) carry earlier verdicts from other arms.
overlapDisclosure.whyNotReplacement: No earlier verdict is replaced, revised or reinterpreted. The control's 2026-10-05 reading stays canonical for its own window; this pair adds a second reading of the same text in a new window precisely so the window difference is visible instead of assumed. The candidate's text is the 2.15.0 arm's own bytes, whose 2026-10-04 four-cell verdicts stand unchanged; its 30-cell reading is new.
overlapDisclosure.officialMetric: Each arm's own frozen report is the only source for its verdicts; the candidate's pass count is read against the frozen bar in full, on the 26 cells that carry no earlier verdict, and against its same-window control.

predeclaredReading.betterIs: The candidate is read as better only if it passes STRICTLY MORE than 21 of the 30 predeclared tasks - the frozen reference count from run 37332662525 - AND its pass count is not lower than its own same-window control's. A tie with the reference is not a gain and a loss is a loss; the reference is never replaced by the same-window control.
predeclaredReading.sameWindowVeto: The same-window control is a veto, never a substitute for the bar: if the candidate clears 21 but the same-window control reads equal or higher, the text is not read as a gain and is not merged. If the same-window control reads lower than 21, that observation is recorded and does not move either the reference or the bar.
predeclaredReading.whyStrict: Every arm of this program has carried a real verdict in all 30 cells, so the completion tie-break cannot decide anything, and three prompt variants have now read 18, 20 and 17 against 21 with single-attempt cells that flip between windows for the same text. The pair exists to stop a one-cell difference from being read as an effect.
predeclaredReading.affectedCells: The preservation sentence can only act on work that probes supplied data files with exploratory tools, and the project's own records name terminal-bench/db-wal-recovery as the cell class it was written for; the other cells remain in the reading because a prompt edit can also cost them. A pass-count difference here is a reading about these cells on this corpus, never a general capability claim.
predeclaredReading.completion: Completion is read per arm as cells with a real graded verdict versus cells left without one (error / not-evaluated / pre-model environment failure / provider transport failure); a verdict-less cell is a binding failure, never a capability loss, and an arm with a verdict-less cell cannot claim the bar from an incomplete reading.
predeclaredReading.score: Score is not used as a bar; the discriminating readings are the pass count, the paired same-window difference, the datacurve fail-to-pass fraction and the per-cell flips.
predeclaredReading.delivery: On the two graded read-back cells (/app/recovered.json, /app/out.txt) presence and first-write time are read exactly as before; no arm has ever written /app/out.txt.
predeclaredReading.cost: Any cell whose disposition or failing set regresses against either the reference or the same-window control is recorded as cost even if the count moves forward.
predeclaredReading.censoring: A cell bounded by its budget or a declared stop is a right-censored observation reported with its span: never excluded, never counted as a gain.
predeclaredReading.uncertainty: One attempt per cell; the candidate and its control run in the same window, so this pair's internal difference carries much less window difference than the earlier single-arm contrasts, but it still carries provider load, runner capacity and single-attempt variance. Nothing here is an effect size.

fairnessDisclosures: No user prefix, no task-specific hint, no grader output and no evaluator feedback reaches either arm; the only deltas are the text versions themselves.

The candidate text names no task, file, path, value, tool alias, evaluator or grader, is ASCII-only, and states generic discipline; the six forbidden host-mechanism names are absent and enforced by the pinned negative loop.
One attempt per cell per arm; no best-of-N, no retry-until-pass, no cell exclusion, no latency threshold, no cell dropped for being slow.
Both arms are dispatched from their own frozen refs; neither ref is moved after dispatch.
Task environments are internet-connected as frozen (no closed-book claim); any cell with an upstream-fetch signature is recorded, never credited as a delivery or pass mechanism.
The 2026-10-05 control reading and every arm's verdicts stay published; nothing here is merged by the study alone, and no verdict of any earlier study is reinterpreted.
